verses.serigne-babacar-sy-ya-rahilan-c1-v1: yā rāḥilā mutasābiqa r-rukbāni naḥwa l-jināni r-rawḥi war-rayḥāni
verses.serigne-babacar-sy-ya-rahilan-c1-v2: ʾaddi l-ʾulūkata min ʾasīri ʿalāqati qāsī l-hawājisi muddata l-ʾazmāni
verses.serigne-babacar-sy-ya-rahilan-c1-v3: ʾaddi l-bayāna liʾahlihā mutasāʿifā bil-wāfidīna wajumlahi s-sukkāni
verses.serigne-babacar-sy-ya-rahilan-c1-v4: lawlā maqādīru l-ḥakīmi ʾilahinā ʿarafū bimā ʾaḥwī bihadhā sh-shāni
verses.serigne-babacar-sy-ya-rahilan-c1-v5: lā taqṣiranna tawassulā wataḍarruʿā wataraqquqā bil-ʿayni wat-tijāni
verses.serigne-babacar-sy-ya-rahilan-c1-v6: sal mā wasalhu ziyādata bitaqarrubi kadhawī l-gharābti sāḥiqī l-ʾawṭāni
verses.serigne-babacar-sy-ya-rahilan-c1-v7: baḥru tamawwaja qaʿruhu wayafīḍu min ʾidhni l-muhaymini bāriʾi l-ʾakwāni
verses.serigne-babacar-sy-ya-rahilan-c1-v8: yughnī l-qawāṣida ʾidh ʾatā lil-ʾāliʾi mutazāḥimī l-ʾaṣdāfi wal-marjāni
verses.serigne-babacar-sy-ya-rahilan-c1-v9: yūḥu badat tuʿyī l-warā bitaʿāyuni min kulla nāʾi nāẓiri wal-ʾānī
verses.serigne-babacar-sy-ya-rahilan-c1-v10: watashaʿshaʿat ʾaḍwāʾuhā washuʿāʿuhā wataʿʿumu bil-ʾaqṭāri wal-buldāni
verses.serigne-babacar-sy-ya-rahilan-c1-v11: kam shāhadat ʿayna l-ḥaqīqati ʿaynuhu watakashshafat ʿan fatḥihi n-nūrānī
verses.serigne-babacar-sy-ya-rahilan-c1-v12: hadhā lladhī ʾinsānu ʿayni ḥaqīqati mutaṣarrifā biḥaqāʾiqi l-ʿirfāni
verses.serigne-babacar-sy-ya-rahilan-c1-v13: hadhā lladhī kāna l-mumiddu waḥāʾilā bayta l-wilayati fātiḥa l-bībāni
verses.serigne-babacar-sy-ya-rahilan-c1-v14: hadhā lladhī qad nāla riḍwāna l-ʿalī bimunazzali l-ʾāyāti min qurʾāni
verses.serigne-babacar-sy-ya-rahilan-c1-v15: waḥawā bimarḍāti l-ʿalīmi bisabʿihi min muqtaḍā l-qurʾāni wal-furqāni
verses.serigne-babacar-sy-ya-rahilan-c1-v16: khatma l-walayata mā khafā ʾamru bihi khatma n-nubuwwati jadduhu wal-ḥānī
verses.serigne-babacar-sy-ya-rahilan-c1-v17: huwa majmaʿu l-baḥrayni ʿaynu ʿināyati biwirāthiti min minḥahi r-raḥmāni
verses.serigne-babacar-sy-ya-rahilan-c1-v18: watawātarat rutabu lahu min baʿdimā rutabi bila ḥaṣri walā kitmāni
verses.serigne-babacar-sy-ya-rahilan-c1-v20: hadhā salīlu muḥammadi dhā sālimu ḥaqqā ʾabūhu waqudwatu l-ʾazmāni
verses.serigne-babacar-sy-ya-rahilan-c1-v21: huwa qudwatu huwa raghbahu huwa ʿuhdatu huwa ʿumadatu huwa tuḥfahu l-ʾikhwāni
verses.serigne-babacar-sy-ya-rahilan-c1-v22: huwa raḥmahu wahidātu wakafāyatu wamaziyyatu huwa niḥlahu l-ʾinsāni
verses.serigne-babacar-sy-ya-rahilan-c1-v23: qad khaṣṣahu l-mawlā ṭarīqa shafāʿati yakfī s-sulūku bihi ʿani l-burhāni
verses.serigne-babacar-sy-ya-rahilan-c1-v24: man kāna yadkhulahu yanal bishafāʿati min ghayri ʿaddi lā walā mīzāni
verses.serigne-babacar-sy-ya-rahilan-c1-v25: faṣalatuhu biṣalatihi dāmat ʿalā ʿayni n-naʿīmi wasyyidi l-ʾaʿyāni
verses.serigne-babacar-sy-ya-rahilan-c1-v26: wurrāda wirdi maʿīnihi lā taḍjarū wal-ʾajnabī waʾakhu bihā siyyāni
verses.serigne-babacar-sy-ya-rahilan-c1-v27: man kāna yakraʿuhu fala yuṭrad bihi fatawaththaqū bil-ḥaqqi war-rabbānī
verses.serigne-babacar-sy-ya-rahilan-c1-v28: ḥāshā yaʾūbu l-marʾu kāna yaʾummuhu likhaṣāṣati ʿan ẓafrati biḍamāni
verses.serigne-babacar-sy-ya-rahilan-c1-v29: ʾaṣfā l-karīmu lahu l-khaṣāʾiṣa niʿmaha falanā mina l-mawlā bihi luṭfāni
verses.serigne-babacar-sy-ya-rahilan-c1-v30: yā shaykhanā yā ʾaḥmada t-tijānī quṭba l-wujūdi waniʿmaha l-ʾakwāni
verses.serigne-babacar-sy-ya-rahilan-c1-v32: yā ghunyatī yā bughyatī yā munyatī faʾanā l-mutayyamu ʾin ʿarafta kafānī
verses.serigne-babacar-sy-ya-rahilan-c1-v33: walaqad yamamtu janābaka s-sāmī ʿalā ḥāshā yuḍāmu mulāzimu l-ʾardāni
verses.serigne-babacar-sy-ya-rahilan-c1-v34: walaqad waqaftu bibābika d-dāʿī qirā ḥāshā yudhallu ladayhi min ḍiyfāni
verses.serigne-babacar-sy-ya-rahilan-c1-v35: faʾataytu ʾadwāʾa l-janāni muhayyamā naḥwa l-ʿilāji mumārisa l-ʾashjāni
verses.serigne-babacar-sy-ya-rahilan-c1-v36: mā ʿazzakum ʾakhdhu l-yamīni bifaḍlikum fī l-yawmi yakshifu fīhi ʿan sīqāni
verses.serigne-babacar-sy-ya-rahilan-c1-v37: ʾin lam takun khirrītanā bighayāhibi ẓulamātu dahri waylatī min fāni
verses.serigne-babacar-sy-ya-rahilan-c1-v38: falaka l-waṣiyyatu bin-nabī ʾūṣītahā litaḥḥaruzi sh-shayṭāni wallīṭāni
verses.serigne-babacar-sy-ya-rahilan-c1-v39: faʾarāka maṣdūqa l-maqāli ḍamānata bisalāmati l-ʾaḥbābi wal-ʾakhdāni
verses.serigne-babacar-sy-ya-rahilan-c1-v40: ʾanta lladhī jārayta ʾaqṭāba l-ʿalī rutabaa samat fasabaqta ʿan nukrāni
verses.serigne-babacar-sy-ya-rahilan-c1-v41: ʾanta lladhī dalla l-jawābu ʿulawwahu ʾadaba bimajlisi shāfiʿi l-ʾakwāni
verses.serigne-babacar-sy-ya-rahilan-c1-v42: ʾanta lladhī ḥaqqā ʾatayta jawāhirā wafarāʾidā hiyā ḥilyatu l-ʾīmāni
verses.serigne-babacar-sy-ya-rahilan-c1-v43: ʾanta lladhī qadamāka qad ʿalatā ʿalā ʾahli l-muhaymini ḥuẓẓiẓat hātāni
verses.serigne-babacar-sy-ya-rahilan-c1-v44: narjū l-khilāṣata was-salāmata sayyadī ʿannā kshifanna ʿaẓāʾimi l-ʾaḥzāni
verses.serigne-babacar-sy-ya-rahilan-c1-v45: lī zafratu l-ʾaḥshā fuwayqa l-mustamā fakaʾannanī min fāʾizi ṭ-ṭūfāni
verses.serigne-babacar-sy-ya-rahilan-c1-v46: lī ghurratu l-ʾaʿḍā biḥusni ʿibādati faʾataytu muʿtarifā bilā sulṭāni
verses.serigne-babacar-sy-ya-rahilan-c1-v47: lī ḥayratu muʿtādatu bimaḥabbahi mutalāzimu l-jawlāni wal-hayamāni
verses.serigne-babacar-sy-ya-rahilan-c1-v48: lī ghīratu zawriyyatu bijanābikum ʾanta s-samūḥu wanukhbahu l-ʾakwāni
verses.serigne-babacar-sy-ya-rahilan-c1-v49: lī raghbahu faʾabā l-wuṣūla maqādiru ʾayna s-sabīlu ʾilayka bil-wujdāni
verses.serigne-babacar-sy-ya-rahilan-c1-v50: falaʾin ʾataytukum ʿimādī zallaha ḥilmu l-judūdi tamarruḥu l-wildāni
verses.serigne-babacar-sy-ya-rahilan-c1-v51: ḥamdā liman qad khaṣṣanā min faḍlihi biṭarīqika ṣ-ṣāfī s-sanī n-nūrānī
verses.serigne-babacar-sy-ya-rahilan-c1-v52: wakafā nḥiyāshu dāʾimu nuʿzā bihi nuḥẓā bihi fī l-ʿālami r-rūḥānī
verses.serigne-babacar-sy-ya-rahilan-c1-v53: niʿma nḥiyāshu s-sālikīna ʾilā l-munā wayaḥḥufuhum ḥifẓu ladā l-ʾarkāni
verses.serigne-babacar-sy-ya-rahilan-c1-v54: faṣalātu rabbī maʿ salāmi dāʾimā ʾabadā ʿalā khayri l-warā l-ḥannāni
verses.serigne-babacar-sy-ya-rahilan-c1-v55: wabīʾālihi l-ʾaṭhāri bal ʾaṣḥābihi mā nāḥa rqu l-ʾayki fī l-ʾaghṣāni
verses.serigne-babacar-sy-ya-rahilan-c1-v19: huwa ʾaḥmadu bnu maḥammadi najli l-walī l-mukhtāri najli l-jaddi ʾaḥmada dāni
verses.serigne-babacar-sy-ya-rahilan-c1-v31: yā ʾayyuhā t-tāju s-saniyyū wabarzakhu l-ʾaqṭābi wal-maktūmi ʿālī sh-shāni
